title: feat: Console navigation — replace HTML5 DnD with @dnd-kit, add nav pinning, add AppSchemaRenderer slots
body:
Completes P1–P3 Console navigation integration: upgrades drag reorder from HTML5 DnD to `@dnd-kit`, adds navigation-level pinning alongside record favorites, and begins AppSchemaRenderer migration by delegating navigation rendering to `NavigationRenderer`.

### P1: Drag Reorder → @dnd-kit

- Removed custom `DndContext` (React context), `draggable` attrs, and `onDragStart/Over/Drop` handlers from `AppSidebar`
- Delegates to `NavigationRenderer` which uses `@dnd-kit/core` + `@dnd-kit/sortable` (PointerSensor, KeyboardSensor, 5px activation)
- `useNavOrder` adapted to work with `NavigationRenderer`'s `onReorder(items)` callback; localStorage persistence unchanged

### P2: Navigation Pin

- New `useNavPins` hook — localStorage-persisted pin/unpin for nav items, `applyPins()` for nested trees
- Wired via `NavigationRenderer`'s `enablePinning` + `onPinToggle`
- Coexists with existing `useFavorites` (record-level)

### P3: AppSchemaRenderer Migration (Phase 1)

- Added `sidebarHeader` and `sidebarExtra` slots to `AppSchemaRenderer` — `sidebarHeader` replaces default branding header, `sidebarExtra` renders after navigation
- `AppSidebar` now delegates navigation tree to `NavigationRenderer`, removing ~120 lines of duplicated `NavigationTree`/`NavigationItemRenderer`/HTML5 DnD code
- Console-specific features (app switcher, user footer, favorites, recent items) preserved in the Sidebar wrapper

```tsx
// AppSidebar now delegates to NavigationRenderer with @dnd-kit + pinning
<NavigationRenderer
  items={processedNavigation}
  basePath={basePath}
  evaluateVisibility={evalVis}
  checkPermission={checkPerm}
  searchQuery={navSearchQuery}
  enablePinning
  onPinToggle={togglePin}
  enableReorder
  onReorder={handleReorder}
/>
```

### Tests

- 11 tests for `useNavPins` (pin/unpin, persistence, nested items, corruption handling)
- 6 tests for `AppSchemaRenderer` slots (`sidebarHeader`, `sidebarExtra`, combined slots)
- 3 tests for `AppSidebar` DnD/pin integration
- All 425 console tests pass, all 77 layout tests pass

> ## ✨ 剩余集成任务列表
> 
> ### P1. Navigation Drag Reorder 升级
> - **目标**：用 `@dnd-kit` 替换 Console 当前使用的原生 HTML5 DnD（`draggable`, `onDragStart/Over/Drop`），提升可用性与交互体验。
> - **内容**：
>   - 使用 `@object-ui/layout` 提供的 `SortableNavigationItem` 和 `NavigationRenderer`（PR objectstack-ai/objectui#698 功能已完整）
>   - 实现 PointerSensor/KeyboardSensor，保持 grip handles 等 UX
>   - 保留原有 `useNavOrder` hook 的 localStorage 持久化功能（需适配新的拖拽顺序存储）
>   - 全量回归测试，确保与 Console 其他 DnD（如 Kanban）行为无冲突
>   - 优先处理 sidebar navigation 区域的拖拽
> 
> ### P2. Navigation Pin 功能集成
> - **目标**：将 `@object-ui/layout` 的导航项 Pin（side bar navigation item 级别收藏）集成到 Console，补充原有 record 级别 favorites，支持收藏导航条目并置顶。
> - **内容**：
>   - 对比现有 Console 的 `useFavorites()` hook（record 收藏），与 package 层 pin/unpin、collectPinnedItems 逻辑并存
>   - 增加新 UX：Favorites section 可同时显示 record favorites 与 navigation pinned，需区分展示类型与操作入口
>   - 支持 pin/unpin 导航条目，置顶显示
>   - 完善交互和测试用例
> 
> ### P3. AppSchemaRenderer 整体迁移
> - **目标**：将 Console 的 `AppSidebar.tsx`（现有自实现逻辑：area switch、navigation tree、icon/visibility/permission、recent items、app switcher 等）整体迁移到 `@object-ui/layout` 的 `AppSchemaRenderer`，实现架构升级。
> - **内容**：
>   - 将 Console 特有功能（app switcher dropdown、user footer、recent items、swipe gesture、本地 DnD）迁移为 `AppSchemaRenderer` 的 slot/props/扩展接口
>   - 删除重复能力，提升测试覆盖率与维护效率
>   - 回归测试确保 feature parity
>   - 分阶段迁移：
>     - 阶段一：接口适配 package 层逻辑
>     - 阶段二：业务差异补齐
>     - 阶段三：全面回归与集成 badge/search/pin/reorder 等增强
>
